stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 3 & 8 - the handicapper has questions

stories.detail: 4 straight 3-pointers on holes 5-8

stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 11 - that'll do nicely

stories.title: Runaway
stories.detail: 5 clear at the top - daylight second

stories.detail: 18 places up and still accelerating, Robert Balding is peaking at exactly the right time of year.

stories.detail: Cheers to Richard Allsopp from Royal Sydney GC for making the drive, come back and do it again soon.

stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 4 marker sitting 7th

stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ from 18 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 17, 1-pointer on hole 18

stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 1, 2 & 3

stories.detail: 5th to 16th for Justin Wunsch, a ladder slip rather than a full rebuild.

comingLast.roast: in the clubhouse on 23, and yes, everyone knows where he is sitting
escape number: 9. holes remaining: 6. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
on 17 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
on 21 at 1.4 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
4 left, 4 needed, one bar holding its breath
the rescue mission: 5 points, 5 holes, no pressure at all
his round is over, his sweating is not - 1 above the line
in the clubhouse 2 above Crouch - cheering for him from a safe distance
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
safe by 3 unless the course gets generous late
